purpose: Test simultaneous sign switches and AR1 regime switches when the target is the post-change direction.

policies.SG052: Trailing 100 observed samples, median-bin HAC3, calibrated interval z=4.327111573414373; no change-point detector, no future-looking observation beyond t240; after-change truth only used to score

classification: Positive if CI low>0; negative if CI high<0; zero if CI entirely inside ±.0032; otherwise unresolved.

calibration.method: 90% empirical split quantile of |trailing100 slope - known programmed post-change slope| / trailing HAC3 SE

pilot.note: Inspected before freeze; increase in abstentions 55, reduction in errors 51; no rule or multiplier retuning after pilot.

main_metrics: error counts by direction and noise

caveats: True change time not known to policy; fixed trailing100 includes no prechange samples for onsets <=140.
This tests full-observation window decisions, not online stopping or actual adaptation.
The generator uses known noise classes; fresh seeds alone do not establish out-of-family transfer.
Comparators have nonoptimal full-history estimates for post-change target, so policy gain does not establish a universal optimum.
